notes.title: Patch 0.8.146771: UI & Other Fixes
notes.notes:
[h3]After last week's update that brought [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1677970/view/562503219018727993"]a slew of major changes[/url], we're rolling out a small batch of patches, smoothing out a few UI issues and introducing a handful of fixes. [b][u]

UI:[/u][/b] [/h3][list][*][p]Train list station filter contains player's color marker for multiplayer sessions;[/p][/*][*][p]James Hall's portrait is now shown properly in Chapter five;[/p][/*][*][p]Oil power plant earnings effect is now shown properly when upgrading;[/p][/*][/list][h3]
[b][u]Fixes:[/u][/b][/h3][list][*][p]Trains now pass crossroads properly;[/p][/*][*][p]Restarting of a mission in a campaign now keeps skill points;[/p][/*][*][p]Bank and Power plants earnings count properly in multiplayer sessions;[/p][/*][*][p]Oil well capacity fixed in certain missions;[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.8.14719: Power plants, resource system, balancing and fixes
notes.notes:
[h3][u][b]Gameplay:[/b][/u][/h3][list][*][p]Oil Power Plant and Coal Power Plant buildings added to the game; [/p][/*][*][p]Produced electricity can now be sold to citizens or used in production; [/p][/*][*][p]Chemical Factory now consumes electricity to produce fertilizers and chemicals; [/p][/*][*][p]Chemicals are now required to produce Dynamite in an Explosives Plant; [/p][/*][*][p]Dynamite can be used to restore exhausted mines; [/p][/*][*][p]Clay pits have unlimited deposits but require electricity for deeper extraction; [/p][/*][*][p]Oil wells are now unlimited, but deeper pumping increases upkeep; [/p][/*][*][p]Competitive Mode is now available for generated multiplayer maps; [/p][/*][*][p]Added resource capacity scenario options for multiplayer maps; [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][u][b]Balancing:[/b][/u][/h3][list][*][p]City Hall's internal consumption rate has been reduced; [/p][/*][*][p]Contracts for produced commodities will now appear later; [/p][/*][*][p]Banks provide services to a limited number of citizens on a monthly basis; [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][u][b]UI:[/b][/u][/h3][list][*][p]Full/empty notifications can be managed per warehouse; [/p][/*][*][p]Alt+Click on commodities now sets the correct number of carriages in the route planner; [/p][/*][*][p]Added a "Delete All Old Save Files" button; [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed 'researched' symbol for Geology map cells; [/p][/*][*][p]While a train is selected, clicking on a city or a commodity on the map will always add it to the train's route. [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][u][b]Fixes:[/b][/u] [/h3][list][*][p]Trains now move against road direction if the path was set before the semaphore switched; [/p][/*][*][p]Bridge pillars no longer disappear on long bridge; [/p][/*][*][p]Bridge and tunnels were not built properly in some cases; [/p][/*][*][p]Players can not launch auctions before building an office; [/p][/*][*][p]Localization improvements.
[/p][/*][/list][p][i]Please note that, due to the significant changes made in this update, we've run into another (this time, smaller) issue when it comes to your save files. While post-mission save files will be still be compatible, those made during a mission will not. Just like last time, you'll still be able to access the previous version through a separate branch, to tie up any loose deals.[/i][/p]

notes.title: Patch 0.8.14136: Balancing and fixes
notes.notes: [h3][b][u]Balancing:[/u][/b][/h3][list][*][p]Cities will now buy local commodities with less intensity to prevent early depletion;[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Office staff will now have positive and negative skills more often;[/p][/*][/list][h3][b][u]Fixes:[/u][/b][/h3][list][*][p]Video card driver updates now work properly;[/p][/*][*][p]Misleading "failed" text for objective will not appear now;[/p][/*][*][p]Some geology staff skills not show proper effects values;[/p][/*][*][p]Farm building cannot be constructed in Chapter 5;[/p][/*][*][p]Sausage Factory building cannot be constructed in Chapter 5;[/p][/*][*][p]Cotton fields now consume fertilizers;[/p][/*][*][p]Achievements will now be issued according to completed chapter;[/p][/*][*][p]Depleted cross marker now has a proper material;[/p][/*][*][p]Railroad construction particle effects optimized;[/p][/*][*][p]Localization improvements.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.8.14024: New features, rebalancing, and a variety of fixes
notes.notes:
We’re happy to share a new, exciting update today! 

[i][b] ⚠️ Please note that this update comes with a full save wipe due to major system changes.[/b][/i]

[u][b]Gameplay[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] New mission added to North Subjugation campaign
[*] CEO skill points and skills chart added to North Subjugation campaign
[*] Added Trading Department to office building
[*] Added contracts for goods delivery
[*] Finance Department now allows taking loans and issuing corporate bonds
[*] The finance staff now have skills related to bonds and loans
[*] Company Credit Rating system implemented
[*] Added 4-4-2 Atlantic locomotive to research chart
[*] Added new production building – Chemical Plant
[*] Added Trading Academy social building
[/list]

[u][b]Balancing[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Commodity price and consumption speed now depends on the volume of consumption
[*] Seller price in some cases can now be higher than a buyer price
[*] Initial buy-sell price gap has been reduced
[*] Natural resources available for mining are now limited
[*] Different mineral deposits now contain different capacities
[*] Different capacity resource presets are enabled in generated scenarios
[*] Grain and cotton fields’ production is limited by soil saturation and now consumes fertilizers
[*] Resource capacity is included in the beginning options for generated scenarios
[*] Changes to commodity weights now affect all commodities on the map simultaneously
[*] More staff will be spawned in multiplayer sessions
[*] Multiplayer skill book effects rebalanced
[*] Research projects are now performed faster in multiplayer sessions
[*] License prolongation price can now be adjusted in the beginning scenario settings for generated scenarios
[*] In North Subjugation campaign, player will not lose when all extra funding is spent
[/list]

[u][b]UI[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Other player locomotives can now be selected in multiplayer sessions
[*] A route can now be copy-pasted between trains in the train side panel
[*] Added money balance tooltip indicating company monthly costs
[*] FPS overlay dialog hotkey switched to F7 (instead of F12)
[*] Staff members can now be fired directly from the department
[*] Added cost marker fly-up for semaphores and railroads
[*] Added sound when all players are "ready" in multiplayer lobby
[*] Railroads and railroad station colors are now visible on the minimap in the Lobbying department
[*] Save files from previous game versions are marked as not supported
[*] Other UI improvements
[/list]

[u][b]Fixes[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Parallel railroad tool (Alt) is now working properly for slopes and bridges
[*] Parallel bridge construction is not causing the raising of the soil level
[*] Train movement and pathfinding logic enhanced
[*] Now cities are developing further beyond the laid railroad lines
[*] Train breakdowns are now properly synchronized in multiplayer sessions
[*] Train badge now correctly focuses with the player camera
[*] Carriage masses are now shown properly in the cargo tab of a train
[*] Locomotive tech parameters are now properly synchronized in multiplayer sessions
[*] Laws now appear properly for newly established cities
[*] Buildings effects are now updated properly in a building UI
[*] No crash occurs after multiple generations in a single-player generated scenario
[*] Train used to freeze before entering the station in some cases
[*] Player color was not saved from the previous multiplayer session
[*] A commodity is now always available on the map if enabled during map generation
[/list]

[u][b]Other[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Improvements in localization.
[/list]

notes.title: An Exciting New Update Rolls Into Railroad Corporation 2!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We hope you’ve all been enjoying your time on the rails, building networks, striking deals, and growing your corporation one station at a time!

Today, we’re excited to[b] bring you a brand-new update![/b] This one’s packed with exciting features, balancing improvements, and quality-of-life upgrades that we think will make your railroad adventures even more engaging.

[u][h5]New Features:[/h5][/u]
The [b]North Subjugation campaign has been expanded[/b] with a brand-new mission and [b]a full CEO skills system[/b]. You’ll also find a [b]Trading Department now available[/b] in your office, contracts for goods delivery, and a Finance Department overhaul that introduces loans, bonds, and a company credit rating system. More strategic depth? You got it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41371493/b7175c4346f3787e6abbe87819e098d41bcd8960.png[/img]
When it comes to trains and infrastructure, we’ve added the [b]4-4-2 Atlantic locomotive[/b] to your research chart and introduced the [b]brand-new Chemical Plant as a production building[/b]. Oh, and there's now a [b]Trading Academy[/b] social building to boot.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41371493/e44f48a8079064d0076a892b6b610e684e593f9f.png[/img]
We’ve also [b]rebalanced commodity pricing, mining resources, and multiplayer staffing[/b], among other adjustments to help the economic simulation feel even more dynamic and responsive.

And yes, there’s a whole wave of [b]UI upgrades, bug fixes, and localization improvements[/b] that should make your railroad empire a smoother ride.

[b][i]⚠️ Please note: This update comes with a full save wipe due to major system changes. But don’t worry—if you want to finish up your current playthrough first, the old version is still available on a separate branch.[/i][/b]

You can check out the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1677970/view/505078875556937859]full patch notes[/url] for all the details. As always, thanks for being part of our journey. We can’t wait to hear what you think of the new additions!

notes.title: Patch 0.8.12750: Generated Scenarios, UI fixes & balancing improvements
Patch 0.8.12156: Autumn biome & 3 new maps
notes.notes:
We’re thrilled to share the latest update for the game! This time, we’re introducing [b]the Autumn Biome (A.K.A. the "green biome") with three brand-new maps. [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41371493/17c7de6689c8250172a25b34e360018c940ddd4a.png[/img]

[u][b]Autumn Journey[/b][/u]
A single-player endless mode with no objectives, designed for creative exploration and experimentation. This map is larger than the ‘Frozen Lakes’ map you’ve gotten to know so well by now.

[u][b]Nature of Competition[/b][/u]
A competitive 2-4 player versus map with specific objectives focused on managing and delivering certain commodities.

[u][b]Mutual Fund[/b][/u]
A cooperative multiplayer map that illustrates a collaborative plan to fund and develop a railroad network in a resource-rich area, addressing regulatory requirements and shared risks.

We do advise players to play the Frozen Lakes or Northern Subjugation maps first as those include vital tutorial elements explaining core mechanics. 

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[u][b]Why an Autumn Biome in Winter?[/b][/u]

We’ve received numerous requests for an alternative to the winter biome since our Early Access release. To accommodate this, we prioritized the Autumn Biome earlier in our roadmap.
And yes, we know it’s winter, so releasing an autumn-themed update might seem...unexpected. Think of it as a cozy warm-up to the snowier adventures ahead!

The Autumn Biome sets the stage for new main campaign chapters that will be created using this new biome.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[u][b]Key Features in the Update[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] [b]Larger Sandbox Map:[/b] Autumn Journey offers more space to explore than Frozen Lakes. However, we still encourage new players to start with Frozen Lakes or Northern Subjugation, since they offer a clear introduction to the mechanics of Railroad Corporation 2
[*] [b]New Versus Map Objectives:[/b] Multiplayer objectives now emphasize specific commodities, adding a fresh layer of strategic challenge.
[*] [b]New Cooperative Map:[/b] Large cooperative map with a variety of challenges. Great for co-op players who already have some experience in Railroad Corporation 2.
[/list]
[b]Improvements and Fixes[/b]
Here's a list of all changes and improvements. As always, you can also follow the change log [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1677970/discussions/0/4699035743124830016/]over on our Steam discussions thread. [/url]

Patch change log:

Content
    - Added three new maps set in a brand-new Autumn biome.

Balancing
    - Adjusted research values for the Mason Bogie locomotive.
    - Large bakery stores are now allowed to be constructed.

Fixes
    - Resolved an issue where multiplayer sessions could not be loaded after geology succeeded.
    - Fixed a bug where newly created cities were missing a City Hall in some cases.
    - Addressed an issue where not all commodities were visible in the Warehouse panel.
    - Corrected a problem where trains occasionally failed to leave a station without an obvious reason.

notes.title: Patch 0.8.11493: Multiplayer Saving, Improved Taxes, and more!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We’re thrilled to bring you another exciting update for Railroad Corporation 2! First, a big thank you to all of you—our dedicated community of players—for your support and valuable feedback. Your passion for the game keeps us motivated to improve and innovate with every update. 

After last week’s addition of the ability to place multiple semaphores using Shift + click on a single railroad segment, today’s update introduces some highly requested features, along with some quality-of-life enhancements to make your experience smoother. Let’s dive into what’s new in this release!


[list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41371493/3ec44beb4d999c19deffe8a0dadb7651d51977c5.png[/img]

Major Updates
[*] [b]Multiplayer Save/Load Mechanic[/b]
You asked, and we delivered! Now you can save and load games in Multiplayer mode, making it easier to keep your epic multiplayer games on track and pick up where you left off.

[*] [b]Tax Payment Mechanic Improvement[/b]
Managing your finances just got better! We’ve fine-tuned the tax payment system, ensuring a smoother and more intuitive experience when balancing your books. After tax is calculated, player will receive one payment reminder. After the year ends, players have to more months to pay off taxes..

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41371493/727fcd26bb7be36fbccc8e4c4c411b97e0032439.png[/img]

[*] [b]Employee Indicators[/b]
Ever wondered which employees aren’t currently engaged in projects? Worry no more! A new indicator now highlights idle employees, helping you optimize your workforce with ease.[/list]

Additionally, we’ve been rolling out minor improvements - such as localization enhancements and UI improvements - with each patch. You can always find a detailed change log of all patch notes in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1677970/discussions/0/4699035743124830016/][b]on our Steam Discussions thread. [/b][/url]

Once again, thank you for being part of the Railroad Corporation 2 journey. We hope you enjoy these new additions and improvements! Stay tuned for more updates, and as always, keep the feedback coming. See you on the tracks!

Corbie Games

notes.title: Patch 0.8.11311: Balancing, UI, and Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
[b]Hey everyone,[/b]

Time for another update on the progress we’re making in Railroad Corporation 2’s Early Access phase! As we roll out patches over the coming months, we’ll be keeping you up-to-date on our progress right here and on [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1677970/discussions/0/4699035743124830016/?snr=1_5_9_]our Steam Discussions thread.[/url]

Today, we’re [b]addressing a few more errors & bugs, while also addressing balancing & UI issues[/b]. Once again, we can’t thank you enough for your feedback. We’re committed to going through it and resolving as many issues as possible in this Early Access phase.

Here’s a full breakdown of our most recent patch notes:

[*] Multiple semaphores can now be placed via Shift + click on a single railroad segment

[b]Balancing:[/b]
[list]
[*] Production building demolishing costs have been reduced
[*] Demolishing bridges now returns more money
[*] Office building level effects have been reworked[/list]
[b]UI:[/b]
[list]

[*] One-way semaphores are now preselected by default

[/list]
[b]Others:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an error that caused Chapter 2 achievement to unlock earlier
[*] Fixed an error that caused inability to upgrade Sausage Factory
[*] Fixed an absence of technologies on the 2nd and 3rd levels of oil well and refinery
[*] Fixed an error that prohibited Law school construction in the Frozen Lakes scenario

This is just the start of our journey after the launch, and we're dedicated to maintaining the momentum. So, please continue sharing your feedback as we work to make Railroad Corporation 2 the best experience possible!

Corbie Games

notes.title: Patch 0.8.11073: Bug fixes and localization improvements
Railroad Corporation 2 Launch Date Update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We wanted to dedicate a log today to update you all about the release date of Railroad Corporation 2. After much consideration, we’ve made the tough decision to delay the launch to October 21st, 2024.

We know how eager you are to dive into the game, and we truly appreciate all the excitement and support we've received. However, after some extensive testing, we've identified a number of bugs and areas that require our immediate attention. To ensure that player experiences are as smooth, fun, and polished as possible before the Early Access release, we feel that we need a bit more time to work through these issues.

We understand that delays can be disappointing, and we sincerely apologize for this. That being said, we believe that with the extra time taken, it’ll be worth it in the long run, and we’re excited to share the improved version of the game with you soon.

If you have any questions, feedback, or like to stay updated, feel free to drop them on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1677970/discussions/]Steam Discussion page[/url], or on our [url=https://discord.gg/iceberginteractive]Discord[/url].

Thank you again for your patience and continued support. We’ll keep you updated with our progress and will have more to share as we approach the new launch date!

See you on October 21st!

Corbie Games & Iceberg Interactive

notes.title: Alpha Demo Patch Notes 0.5.5712
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

It's been almost 2 days since we've released the Alpha Demo, and we've been receiving bug reports, feedback, and suggestions pouring in from both the Steam discussion board and Discord.

We'd like to personally thank you all of your for your support and valuable comments! We have carefully considered all inputs received. Your feedback is incredibly invaluable to us, and we encourage you to continue sharing your thoughts, not matter how big or small, as the alpha demo will remain available available up to the 15th of January!

With this, we'd like to release a small update based on your feedback that aims at addressing and enhancing minor issues that are relatively straightforward and quick to fix.

[u][b]Changelog 0.5.5712:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Quests are now completed during game pause.
[*] Locomotive engine and ambient sounds have been tuned.
[*] Tech details button is now functions in a train dialog.
[*] Goal hints are now properly managed, incase the objective is completed earlier than requested.
[*] Cargo weight is now properly shown in a cargo bar.
[*] Letters and goals hints are hidden when a locomotive technical details scene is active.
[*] Edited the Buy Locomotive button look on Train stations.
[*] Added a hint to a train condition bar showing current mileage and age.
[*] Station facilities tooltips fixed.
[*] Train station scale is reduced in cities.
[*] 16:10 resolution monitors the game will now be switched to 16:9.
[*] Trains pathfinding improvements.
[*] Local trading UI improvements.
[*] Other minor UI fixes & improvements.
[/list]

If you haven't seen any specific changes mentioned for an issue you brought to our attention, it's likely that further investigation is needed, or that we're currently working on it, and will provide a solution soon.

Thank you all for your passion and contributions to improving the Alpha Demo! We deeply appreciate your support and look forward to continuing this journey with you!
